input.description: Correct outdated Larkspur HTTP/3 memory fact

final.result:
Yes. `go.mod` requires `example.com/larkspur v2.0.1`, and the Larkspur changelog says 2.0.0 (2026-08-14) added HTTP/3 support. It's experimental and off by default, so you have to turn it on with the `--h3` flag or `Client{H3: true}`. The proxy targets Go 1.27, so the Go 1.25 support that 2.0 dropped doesn't affect it.

My memory had an older note saying Larkspur doesn't support HTTP/3, which came from the 1.8.0 changelog. I've corrected that note (`01M5Z7Q8B3TD7YTYEGBQVJCFD9`) to match 2.0.
